meta.name: alterlab-pysam
meta.description: Read and write genomic alignment and variant files in Python with pysam (htslib bindings) — SAM/BAM/CRAM alignments, VCF/BCF variants, and FASTA/FASTQ sequences, plus region extraction and per-base coverage/pileup. Use when scripting NGS data-processing pipelines that parse, filter, index, or compute coverage over BAM/CRAM/VCF files. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 用 Python 读写基因组比对和变异文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Python 处理 BAM/VCF 等基因组数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Read and write genomic alignment and variant files in Python
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently process BAM/VCF genomic files in Python

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 Python 读写基因组比对文件（BAM/CRAM）、变异文件（VCF/BCF）和序列文件（FASTA/FASTQ），还能提取特定区域、计算覆盖度。
howto.when: 当你要求处理 NGS 测序数据，比如分析比对结果、查看变异、提取参考序列或计算覆盖度时触发。

say.text: 计算这个 VCF 文件中所有变异的覆盖度。
从参考基因组 FASTA 中提取基因 BRCA1 的序列。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read and write genomic alignment files (BAM/CRAM), variant files (VCF/BCF), and sequence files (FASTA/FASTQ) using Python, and perform region extraction and per-base coverage/pileup analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to process NGS data, such as analyzing alignment results, inspecting variants, extracting reference sequences, or calculating coverage.

say_en.text: Read this BAM file and show reads in chr1:1000-2000.
say_en.note: Claude opens BAM and fetches reads in the region.

say_en.text: Calculate coverage for all variants in this VCF file.
say_en.note: Claude combines BAM and VCF to compute depth per variant.

say_en.text: Extract the BRCA1 gene sequence from the reference FASTA.
say_en.note: Claude uses pysam FastaFile to fetch the region.
